name: phantomtide
what_it_holds: Global maritime intelligence platform for real-time vessel tracking, AIS data analysis, sanctions monitoring, shipping routes and port activity. 124 stars. Generic AIS-based tool, not cruise-specific; data comes from live AIS feeds, not a committed dataset.
why_useful: Could in theory be adapted to track specific cruise-ship IMO numbers for port-call frequency/dwell time as a very indirect capacity-utilization proxy, but it is a general OSINT maritime-intelligence tool with no cruise-specific data or documentation, and likely depends on paid AIS feeds for full coverage.
